subject: Re: Kickoff: ColTran archive colorization
body:
Hi both,

Status: fine-tuning on the first archival dataset is done using the release's custom-dataset path (pretrained ImageNet checkpoint via pretrain_dir, dataset=custom). FID on the held-out archive split: 21.3 for the fine-tuned model vs 27.8 zero-shot — a clear win for fine-tuning. Per Efe's harness we report FID only; the SSIM numbers people keep asking for are meaningless here and I keep deleting them from decks.

Distillation student v0 trains, but the first checkpoint underperforms: FID 31.5. The autoregressive colorizer's sampling diversity is exactly what the feed-forward student loses. Trying a multi-sample distillation target next.

Risk: the second archival dataset is still in privacy review (filed 5/8, so due imminently). If it clears past 6/19 the two-dataset claim for LRB gets thin.

Hyun
